description: This script generates and tests various distinguished name (DN) configurations for cryptographic certificates, including encoding, string types, whitespace handling, and sorting of RDNs.

classes.name: RDN
classes.description: Represents a Relative Distinguished Name (RDN) with multiple attributes, capable of generating its ASN.1 string representation.

classes.name: NameGenerator
classes.description: Builds a sequence of RDNs to generate distinguished names with various attributes and string types for testing purposes.

methods.name: add_attr
methods.description: Adds an attribute to an RDN with specified type, value type, value, and optional modifier.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns the ASN.1 string representation of an RDN or NameGenerator.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates a PEM-encoded name file from a NameGenerator object, invoking OpenSSL to parse ASN.1 configuration.

methods.name: extra_whitespace
methods.description: Adds extra whitespace around the input string.

methods.name: case_swap
methods.description: Swaps the case of characters in the input string.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function executing various test cases for name generation with different string types, encodings, and sorting scenarios.
